require "test_helper"

class NotificationBundlesIntegrationTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  include ActionMailer::TestHelper

  setup do
    @actor = users(:david)
    @four_hour_user = users(:kevin)
    @daily_user = users(:jz)
    @off_user = users(:jason)
    @off_user.create_settings! unless @off_user.settings

    @four_hour_user.settings.update!(bundle_email_frequency: :every_few_hours)
    @daily_user.settings.update!(bundle_email_frequency: :daily)
    @off_user.settings.update!(bundle_email_frequency: :never)

    [ @four_hour_user, @daily_user, @off_user ].each do |user|
      user.notifications.destroy_all
      user.notification_bundles.destroy_all
      user.reload
    end

    @logo_card = cards(:logo)
    @layout_card = cards(:layout)
    @logo_card.assignments.destroy_all
    @layout_card.assignments.destroy_all

    Current.user = @actor
  end

  test "batches each person's notifications into their chosen time window and sends one email per window" do
    t0 = Time.utc(2026, 7, 10, 9, 0, 0)

    travel_to t0 do
      perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ NotifyRecipientsJob ] do
        @logo_card.watch_by(@four_hour_user)
        @logo_card.watch_by(@daily_user)
        @logo_card.watch_by(@off_user)
        @logo_card.comments.create!(body: "First update on logo", creator: @actor)
      end
    end

    # Second notification 1 hour later on another card
    travel_to t0 + 1.hour do
      perform_enqueued_jobs only: [ NotifyRecipientsJob ] do
        @layout_card.watch_by(@four_hour_user)
        @layout_card.watch_by(@daily_user)
        @layout_card.watch_by(@off_user)
        @layout_card.comments.create!(body: "Second update on layout", creator: @actor)
      end
    end

    # No immediate emails were sent
    assert_emails 0

    # Off user has no bundles; 4-hour and daily users each have 1 non-overlapping bundle
    assert_equal 0, @off_user.notification_bundles.count
    assert_equal 1, @four_hour_user.notification_bundles.count
    assert_equal 1, @daily_user.notification_bundles.count

    # At T + 4 hours: 4-hour user's window closes and sends 1 batched email; daily user's window stays open
    travel_to t0 + 4.hours do
      assert_emails 1 do
        perform_enqueued_jobs do
          Notification::Bundle.deliver_all
        end
      end
    end

    four_hour_email = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
    assert_equal [ @four_hour_user.identity.email_address ], four_hour_email.to
    assert_includes four_hour_email.text_part.body.decoded, "First update on logo"
    assert_includes four_hour_email.text_part.body.decoded, "Second update on layout"
    assert @four_hour_user.reload.notification_bundles.sole.delivered?
    assert @daily_user.reload.notification_bundles.sole.pending?

    # At T + 24 hours: daily user's window closes and sends 1 batched email; 4-hour user does not get re-sent
    travel_to t0 + 24.hours do
      assert_emails 1 do
        perform_enqueued_jobs do
          Notification::Bundle.deliver_all
        end
      end
    end

    daily_email = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
    assert_equal [ @daily_user.identity.email_address ], daily_email.to
    assert_includes daily_email.text_part.body.decoded, "First update on logo"
    assert_includes daily_email.text_part.body.decoded, "Second update on layout"
    assert @daily_user.reload.notification_bundles.sole.delivered?
  end

  test "account export, import, and incineration handle notification bundles and frequency settings" do
    Notification.create!(user: @daily_user, source: events(:logo_published), creator: @actor)
    assert_equal 1, @daily_user.reload.notification_bundles.count
    assert_equal 1, Notification::Bundle::Entry.where(account: accounts("37s")).count

    source_account = accounts("37s")
    exporter = @actor
    identity = exporter.identity

    export = Account::Export.create!(account: source_account, user: exporter)
    export.build
    assert export.completed?

    export_tempfile = Tempfile.new([ "export", ".zip" ])
    export.file.open { |f| FileUtils.cp(f.path, export_tempfile.path) }

    source_account_id = source_account.id
    source_account.incinerate
    assert_not Notification::Bundle.where(account_id: source_account_id).exists?
    assert_not Notification::Bundle::Entry.where(account_id: source_account_id).exists?

    target_account = Account.create_with_owner(account: { name: "Imported" }, owner: { identity: identity, name: exporter.name })
    import = Account::Import.create!(identity: identity, account: target_account)
    Current.set(account: target_account) do
      import.file.attach(io: File.open(export_tempfile.path), filename: "export.zip", content_type: "application/zip")
    end

    import.check
    import.process
    assert import.completed?

    imported_user = target_account.users.find_by!(identity: identities(:jz))
    assert_equal "daily", imported_user.settings.bundle_email_frequency
    assert_equal 1, imported_user.notification_bundles.count
    assert_equal 1, imported_user.notification_bundles.sole.notifications.count
  ensure
    export_tempfile&.close
    export_tempfile&.unlink
  end
end

steps.message:
We have implemented email digests for notifications with configurable per-person time windows:

- **User settings (`User::Settings#bundle_email_frequency`)**: Added the `bundle_email_frequency` enum (`never`, `every_few_hours` [4 hours], `daily`, `weekly`, defaulting to `never`), along with pending-window reconciliation when a person updates their frequency and UI/JSON support in `Notifications::SettingsController`.
- **Time-window batching (`Notification::Bundle`, `Notification::Bundle::Entry`, `Notification::Bundlable`)**: Opens a time window starting when the first notification lands, routes subsequent and late-arriving notifications into the already-opened window under lock, and enforces non-overlapping windows per user both in window allocation and model validation.
- **Digest delivery (`BundleMailer`, `Notification::Bundle::DeliverJob`, `config/recurring.yml`)**: Delivers one HTML/text digest email per window grouped by board via `Notification::Bundle.deliver_all` and `Notification::Bundle::DeliverJob`, with full multi-tenant URL context, data export/import manifest support, and comprehensive unit, mailer, controller, and integration tests.
